frame.name: station_lvlh
frame.axes: X radial outward; Y along orbital motion; Z orbit normal

integrator.name: RK4, sample-and-hold force/torque, exact fuel depletion split

assumptions: Planar Clohessy-Wiltshire relative motion about a circular Earth reference orbit; small separation approximation.
Planar body attitude with constant moment of inertia and torque-limited RCS; translation is fully actuated.
Translation and attitude thrusters share propellant and Isp; torque couple propellant uses lever arm.
Constant station spin relative to LVLH; exponential radial approach reference; fixed PD gains.
Capture requires all four tolerances for a dwell interval. Hull exclusion is geometric; no rigid-body contact dynamics or full 6-DOF model.

frame.name: heliocentric_ecliptic
frame.axes: right-handed XY plane; Z normal to plane

integrator.name: Analytic solar two-body Hohmann conic; circular analytic planet motion

assumptions: Ideal coplanar circular Earth/destination orbits around the Sun; not date-specific JPL ephemerides.
Launch phase is solved analytically unless explicitly supplied; a wrong phase fails the arrival tolerance.
Departure and optional capture use patched-conic parking-orbit energy budgets. Sphere-of-influence and local hyperbolic arcs are not propagated.
One-way transfer only; no round-trip, life support, radiation, planetary atmosphere, aerobraking or landing model.
The destination point is the ideal planet-center orbital location; it is not a physical surface collision or a rendered parking orbit.
